newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire's opposition leader ready to meet Mobutu.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's opposition leader ready to meet Mobutu.

text.p: Zaire's radical opposition leader Etienne Tshisekedi said on Thursday he was ready to meet President Mobutu Sese Seko to form a government that could resolve the crisis over the rebellion in eastern Zaire.

"It is high time that members of this country with a measure of responsibility got together to resolve this crisis which is above all an internal political problem," Tshisekedi told a news conference in the Zairean capital.
"I am ready to meet President Mobutu in France as soon as possible so as not to lose more time."
Mobutu, Zaire's president of 30 years, has been convalescing in Europe for close to three months after undergoing surgery for prostate cancer in Switzerland.

During his absence Rwandan-backed rebels have taken over a swath of territory in the east of the Central African state. Over a million Hutu refugees originating from Rwanda and Burundi, as well as hundreds of thousands of Zaireans, have been displaced by the fighting.

Tshisekedi is the principal figure in opposition to Mobutu. He still lays claim to the position of prime minister which he held in 1992, although he was pushed aside by Mobutu the following year. The two men last met officially in December 1992.
Tshisekedi said Tutsi rebels in eastern Zaire led by Laurent Kabila could expect no support from his Union for Democracy and Social Progress party.
The Rwandan-backed rebels say they are fighting to end what they call 30 years of brutal dictatorship under Mobutu.
"We have chosen a non-violent path to change. Kabila has been fighting in the maquis since the 60s," Tshisekedi said.
He added that only a legally founded government with the support and confidence of the people was able to negotiate an end to the bloody conflict in the east.
For the past two weeks student supporters of Tshisekedi have been agitating in the streets of Kinshasa in a bid to topple the centrist government of Prime Minister Kengo wa Dondo.
